evidence_required: the root cause stated in writing
before and after exit statuses for all three gates, with exact SHAs
the regression's own failing result at the baseline commit
diff confined to the lab package and its tests
cost and context accounting for the whole mission
proposed_missions.objective: Diagnose and fix the seat-overbooking defect the lab's frozen report describes, from baseline 4072bfd7, adding a regression that fails at the baseline and passes at the fix. This is the first mission that changes a repository. It is checkable in a way no other first mutating mission would be: an independent human fix for the same defect exists off this baseline, so the Factory's diagnosis and patch can be compared against a known-good one rather than only against a green suite.
proposed_missions.rollback_boundary: A single branch off 4072bfd7, never main. Rollback is deleting that branch; nothing the mission does is visible to another host until a person merges it.
stop_conditions: the fix commit does not move dev-reproduce from exit 1 to exit 0
the added regression passes at the baseline commit
any change lands outside the lab package and its tests
the mission force-updates or rewrites any published ref

proposed_missions.objective: Carry one improvement candidate through baseline measurement and promotion without regressing the lab's own decision boundary. This is last because it is the only mission that changes a project's quality bar rather than its behaviour, and it is the only one whose failure mode is silent.
proposed_missions.rollback_boundary: A single branch off 229b923b, never main, plus the improvement plane's own demotion path. Rollback is demote-then-delete-branch, in that order, so the promotion record and the code go together.
stop_conditions: dev-evaluate moves from exit 0 to any non-zero status
the candidate is promoted without a baseline measurement recorded first
any protected surface declared for the project is touched
the mission changes the evaluator or the fixture rather than the implementation
